<?php
while($line = fgets(STDIN)) {
    echo preg_replace_callback('/(?P<num>\b[1-9][0-9]*)\b/', function ($m) {
        return toOrd($m['num']);
    }, $line);
}

function toOrd(int $num): string {
    $_2 = $num % 100;
    if ($_2 === 11 || $_2 === 12 || $_2 === 13) {
        return $num . 'th';
    }

    $_1 = $num % 10;
    if ($_1 === 1) {
        return $num . 'st';
    } elseif ($_1 === 2) {
        return $num . 'nd';
    } elseif ($_1 === 3) {
        return $num . 'rd';
    } else {
        return $num . 'th';
    }
}
